## Additional Features - **Building Collision** — A buildings index is included for all non-filtered buildings, each carrying a per-building foundation depth in in-game meters. Depths scale with building height and footprint width and are bounded to the **−10 m** to **−80 m** range: single-family homes and low-rise structures anchor at the floor, while the tallest towers with deep piles reach the cap. Freestanding towers, masts, chimneys, and other slender non-occupiable structures are detected by shape and floored to the **−10 m** minimum. Foundation depths drive underground tunnel-clearance collision and are also emitted as a visual `foundations` pmtiles layer visible on the in-game map. Building geometry and heights both come from the ZBGIS Budova national building registry, whose per-building heights are measured from airborne LiDAR (DMR 5.0) and cover the large majority of Slovak buildings. The remainder, which the registry records without a measured height, are treated as single-storey at a height calibrated for their building function. - **Water Depth Index** — A water depth index restricts track placement in water bodies. Slovakia is landlocked, so all water (the Danube and other rivers, lakes, reservoirs) uses a flat **−5 m** index that prevents surface-level track placement. - **Place Name Labels** — Three layers of place name labels are embedded in the map: - _City labels_ — The bundle's anchor cities and regional capitals (krajské mestá) at the metropolitan scale. - _Municipality labels_ — Names of all municipalities (_obce_, including the Bratislava and Košice city boroughs _mestské časti_) within the map boundary. - _Neighborhood labels_ — Sub-municipal settlement names from the SODB statistical hierarchy (_časti obcí_ and basic settlement units _základné sídelné jednotky_). ## Methodology This map is generated through a six-phase pipeline that transforms Slovak government census, building, and employment statistics into georeferenced origin/destination demand points. **Point Seeding:** Candidate points are placed within each basic settlement unit (_základná sídelná jednotka_ / ZSJ) using population-weighted centroids derived from the SODB 2021 per-ZSJ population counts and the native 1 km census grid, dasymetrically distributed against the ZBGIS Budova national building registry filtered by its building-function (BFC) use-class taxonomy. **Mesh Reconciliation:** Initial point populations are refined by solving a constrained convex optimization that approximates each point's mass to residential and economic mesh ideals while preserving per-municipality (_obec_) SODB 2021 census totals. Sub-municipal chochos cascade through the SODB statistical hierarchy — municipality parts (_časti obcí_) and basic settlement units (ZSJ) within them. **Aggregation:** Workplace mass is anchored to the SODB 2021 place-of-work census counts per municipality, so employees are placed where they actually work rather than at a registered head-office address. The sector composition is disaggregated by NACE Rev 2 economic-activity section using the register-based workplace-method employment series from the ŠÚ SR DATAcube, with Eurostat national-accounts splits for the sub-sections the register series does not separate. Each building's implied worker density follows the sector composition of its BFC use-class, calibrated to the municipal employment total. **Commute Assignment:** Commute flows are assigned from the SODB 2021 pair-wise municipality-to-municipality journey-to-work matrix (_dochádzka do zamestnania_), so origin/destination pairs follow the actually-observed census commuting behaviour rather than a synthetic gravity fit. **Special Demand Injection:** Non-commuter demand generators — airports, universities, hospitals, cultural venues, and tourism attractions — are injected as an additive layer as per-facility coverage lands; see the Special Demand section above for the current roster included in this bundle. **Layout Reconciliation:** A final spatial pass resolves point overlaps and ensures map clickability while keeping special-demand locations fixed. ## Data Sources All demand modeling is derived from freely available Slovak government statistical datasets and public geospatial resources. ### Census & Demographics - **2021 Census** (SODB 2021 — _Sčítanie obyvateľov, domov a bytov 2021_: per-obec and per-ZSJ population and employment, the place-of-work anchor, and the pair-wise obec × obec journey-to-work matrix, accessed via the gis.scitanie.sk ArcGIS services) — [ŠÚ SR / scitanie.sk](https://www.scitanie.sk/) - **Workplace Employment** (ŠÚ SR DATAcube `pr3113rr` — register-based employees by workplace method per okres × NACE Rev 2 section; the workplace-side sector anchor) — [ŠÚ SR DATAcube](https://datacube.statistics.sk/) - **National Sector Splits** (Eurostat national-accounts employment `nama_10_a64_e` — NACE sub-section splits for the sections the register series does not separate) — [Eurostat](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/nama_10_a64_e/default/table) ### Geospatial Reference - **Administrative Boundaries** (SODB _hranice_ — municipality _obec_, municipality-part _časť obce_, and basic-settlement-unit ZSJ polygons carrying the 6-digit obec code, from the gis.scitanie.sk ArcGIS services) — [ŠÚ SR / gis.scitanie.sk](https://gis.scitanie.sk/) - **Building Registry** (ZBGIS _Budova_ — national building polygons carrying the ~80-value building-function BFC enumeration and airborne-LiDAR-derived building heights from DMR 5.0; the sole building geometry source for both modeled demand and the building tiles) — [ÚGKK SR / ZBGIS](https://zbgis.skgeodesy.sk/) - **INSPIRE Buildings** (ÚGKK SR INSPIRE HVD Buildings theme — native `numberOfFloorsAboveGround` floor counts and dwelling counts used for storey-height calibration) — [opendata.skgeodesy.sk](https://opendata.skgeodesy.sk/) - **OpenStreetMap** (building-use disambiguation and `building:levels` storey tags joined onto the ZBGIS Budova registry) — [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/) ### Special Demand Statistics - **Airport Passenger Statistics** (annual passengers for the three airports inside bundle boundaries — Bratislava M. Štefánika](https://www.bts.aero/) · [Letisko Košice](https://www.airportkosice.sk/) - **University Enrollment** (CVTI SR _Štatistická ročenka — vysoké školy_: 137 faculty rows across 33 _vysoké školy_, 119,142 _denná_ students; daily-attendance cohort per faculty) — [CVTI SR](https://www.cvtisr.sk/) - **Hospital Registry & Bed Statistics** (MZ SR _kategorizácia nemocníc_ — 92 categorized hospitals plus psychiatric _liečebne_, with per-facility bed counts; positions resolved through the MV SR address register and snapped to the ZBGIS building registry) — [Ministerstvo zdravotníctva SR](https://www.health.gov.sk/) - **Museum, Gallery & Library Registers** (MK SR statutory registers — _register múzeí_, _register galérií_, _zoznam knižníc_ — the institution rosters, with per-institution visitor and loan figures from the KULT annual statistical summaries; the 2024 national museum total of 4.93 M visitors anchors the per-site allocation) — [MK SR — Štatistika kultúry (registers + KULT summaries)](https://www.culture.gov.sk/ministerstvo/statistika-kultury/) - **Cultural Centres & Amphitheatres** (MK SR KULT 3-01 _kultúrno-osvetová činnosť_ — per-facility event and attendance figures for _kultúrne domy_, plus the National Culture Centre's annual report on cultural-education activity) — [MK SR KULT 3-01](https://www.culture.gov.sk/storage/2025/11/KULT3-01_kulturno-osvetova_cinnost-sumar_SR_2024.pdf) · [NOC — Správa o ŠŠZ](https://www.nocka.sk/sprava-o-ssz-za-rok-2024/) - **Tourism & Recreation Visitor Counts** (per-site annual visitor figures for water parks, thermal spas, ski resorts, caves, castles, gardens, zoos and pilgrimage churches — published operator reports, annual accounts, and national rankings; ski resorts are sized from lift capacity on the same method the Czech roster uses) — [Slovakia Travel / Slovenská agentúra pre cestovný ruch](https://slovakia.travel/) ## License This map data is released under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](https://github.com/ahkimn/subwaybuilder-eu-maps/blob/main/LICENSE). ## Credits Map authored by [Yukina-](https://subwaybuildermodded.com/credits/)
